summary: Backend-only testing of new async quiz duel feature ('Freund herausfordern'): POST /api/duels, GET /api/duels/{duel_id}, POST /api/duels/{duel_id}/complete + new `duels` MongoDB collection. All 13 pytest cases pass. Verified DB document structure, indexes (unique duel_id, TTL expires_at), multi-language re-localization via q_index, full creator/opponent completion flow with 409 conflict handling for 2nd+ replays and a 3rd player, and regression sanity on /api/practice + XP/streak isolation.
critical_code_review_comments: _build_duel_question_set reuses the same tier/pool/dedup logic as practice_session, ensuring parity with existing practice flow.

q_index-based re-localization design is correct and confirmed working: GET with lang=de/es returns same tier sequence but different text than lang=en, and same duel_id always returns same 5 questions in same order.

complete_duel correctly distinguishes creator vs opponent by user_id, blocks replay by same user (409), and blocks a 3rd distinct user once both slots are filled (409) -- verified with 3 distinct users (A/B/C).

Verified in DB directly: duels collection has unique index on duel_id and TTL index (expireAfterSeconds=0) on expires_at; new duel doc has expires_at exactly 7 days after created_at; items array shape is {lesson_id, tier, q_index} as expected; creator_result/opponent_user_id/opponent_result correctly null on creation.
No XP/streak/level coupling confirmed for duels in this version -- verified via /api/auth/me before/after a full duel completion cycle for user A, values unchanged.
/api/practice and /api/practice/complete untouched -- practice endpoint returns expected question shape (q/options/answer/explain/tier), unaffected by new duel code.

success_rate.frontend: N/A - not tested (no UI built yet per problem statement)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 fresh test users via signup (TEST_duel_B_*, TEST_duel_C_*) and several duel docs during testing (auto-expire in 7 days via TTL index, no manual cleanup needed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Duel backend feature (Part 1) is fully verified and working correctly: creation, GET with localization (en/de/es), 404 for invalid duel_id, complete flow for creator+opponent with correct 409 handling for replays and 3rd-player blocking, DB schema/indexes correct, no XP/streak side effects, /api/practice regression unaffected. Frontend UI for this feature does not exist yet and was correctly not tested per problem statement -- will need testing when the UI (Part 2) is implemented in a future iteration.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found, all endpoints behave exactly as specified in the requirements.
